# PRFlow Shadow Review — PR #1936 (issue #1855)

**Verdict: APPROVE**

## Diff profile
small diff; not config-only (touches scripts/ + shell helpers); no new types; engine-self-modifying (reviews DevFlow's own implement + test surface); checklist ran.

## Summary
PR #1936 folds label config resolution and outcome classification into `scripts/apply-labels.sh`: a new `--config-key`/`--config-fallback` mode resolves the label list via `config-get.sh`, folds per-label creation (`ensure-label.sh`) in, applies via REST, and prints exactly one stdout outcome token from the closed set {applied, nothing-to-apply, arg-slip, api-failure, config-unreadable} on every path it runs, with stderr breadcrumbs kept byte-identical. `ensure-label.sh` swaps `grep -qiE` already-exists detection for a bash `case` + `shopt -s nocasematch` so a grep-less host classifies correctly. Four implement call sites collapse to one invocation routing on the token. `lib/test/run.sh` gains a behavioral test block and retires the hand-copied normalizer replica and SKILL-mirror grep pins. Two doc/comment corrections. One patch changeset.

## Phase 3 — reviewer findings (all Suggestion-level; none blocking)
1. **config-wrongtype-guard-scalar-fallopen** (silent-failure-hunter, `scripts/apply-labels.sh`): the wrong-type guard only catches the `[object Object]` object sentinel; a bool/number config value coerces to `true`/`false`/digits and is applied verbatim as a garbage label reported `applied`. Bounded — keys are schema string/array, null→fallback, the realistic accidental `{}` object case is caught.
2. **object-sentinel-substring-false-positive** (silent-failure-hunter / pr-test-analyzer, `scripts/apply-labels.sh`): a pathological real label containing `[object Object]` is rejected `config-unreadable`. Fails closed; informational.
3. **incomplete-outcome-token-trigger** (comment-analyzer, `scripts/apply-labels.sh` header): OUTCOME CONTRACT omits the config-get-exit-0 wrong-type path from `config-unreadable`'s trigger description.
4. **folded-ensure-outcome-not-isolated** (pr-test-analyzer, `lib/test/run.sh`): folded ensure-label already-exists path not independently exercised; inert.
5. **config-key-missing-value-untested** (pr-test-analyzer, `lib/test/run.sh`): `--config-key` with no value untested.
6. **drop-empty-middle-entry-untested** (pr-test-analyzer, `lib/test/run.sh`): `A, ,B,`→`A,B` middle-empty-drop has no direct multi-label test.

## Verdict rationale
All fourteen acceptance criteria verified met. Every apply-labels.sh path emits exactly one stdout token; the object-sentinel wrong-type guard fails closed; nocasematch is process-local and unconditionally reset; the byte-identical stderr contract is preserved; collapsed call sites remain fail-closed and record non-success tokens as durable workpad reflections; docs/comment corrections are accurate; anchors and the §4.0.5 bullet count (7→6) updated; no new capability-profiles entry; patch changeset present. No Critical or Major defect surfaced by any of the five reviewers — every finding is an optional Suggestion. **APPROVE.**
